# Profile (home page)

Single centered profile card on a white, full-screen header background.

## Structure

- **Background** (header, screen height, white) → **Profile Card** flex (max-width 440px, column)
  - **Bio** flex (column, items centered):
    1. Avatar — circular 140px image (`hipster-designer-avatar.png`), 2px neutral,200 border
    2. Name — h1, 5xl, weight 800, heading font: "Nick Swivney"
    3. Role — h2, xs, uppercase widest, neutral,500: "Freelance Website Builder"
    4. Availability badge — pill flex-row (hairline neutral,200 border, radius full, padding 1.5/3) with a **Status Dot** custom component (pulsing dot, status: available, 8px) + xs/500 neutral,700 "Available for projects"
    5. Bio line — p, base, centered, neutral,600, relaxed: "I design and build fast, beautiful websites for small studios and startups."
  - **Buttons** flex: Email (black pill, white text + email icon), Mastodon and GitHub (outlined pills)
  - **Selected Work** flex (column, gap 4): xs uppercase widest neutral,500 heading + 3-col grid (gap 3) of three 1/1 rounded-xl images: coffee e-commerce, brand identity, fitness app
  - Divider (neutral,200)
  - Footer — xs uppercase neutral,400: "Building the future, one website at a time."

## Style

Light, bold, high-end: white canvas, black/neutral palette, emerald accent only on the availability dot, full-round pills, xl-rounded work thumbnails.

# Status Dot (custom component)

Custom component id `13BA620D-6131-4CAA-9222-3D1FD8688BA8`, subtitle "Pulsing availability indicator".

A small circular dot with a pulsing ring animation, used in the availability badge on [[pages/profile]].

## Inspector properties

- **Status** — segmented control, `status`: `available` (emerald #00b981) / `unavailable` (red #fb2c36). Default: available.
- **Size** — number, `dotSize`: diameter in px, 6–24, default 8.

## Implementation notes

- Template: outer span `component-{{id}} status-dot status-dot--{{status}}` with a `__ring` span (pulse) and a `__core` span (solid dot). State is branched via `{{status}}` class interpolation — no hooks needed (template `@if` cannot do `==` comparisons).
- CSS: `{{dotSize}}px` sizing interpolated directly; keyframes scoped per instance (`status-dot-pulse-{{id}}`); ring scales 1→2.2 while fading, 2s infinite.
- Colors are hardcoded hex matching the theme's emerald,500 and red,500. If the theme palette changes, update the CSS (or upgrade to themeColor properties with `format: "var(--color-{{value}})"`).
- Both properties are `responsive: false` since values feed CSS, not Tailwind classes.

## See also
- [[pages/profile]]

# editPageContent add ops fail with phantom 'Node not found' errors; successful adds do not persist

## What was being attempted

Adding new components (badge, bio text, work grid) to the Profile page (23FC5BEC-1143-419A-A5C4-9BFBA50E7E91). Set ops on existing nodes worked fine in earlier turns; add ops now fail or silently roll back.

## Context

RapidWeaver Elements, single-page 'Link in Bio' project. Errors reproducible across ~8 attempts over several minutes. Page structure reads consistently via getPageContent.

## What was tried

1. Batch of 1 set + 10 add ops with values → error: Node 'rwBD5CD13C…' not found (an ID not present in my ops or on the page)
2. Re-read page with getPageContent, retried same batch with verified parent IDs → error: Node 'rwCC802374…' not found (again a phantom ID)
3. Smaller batch (set + 3 adds) → error: Node 'rw6CB3FC38…' not found
4. Single add (flex with minimal values) → error: Node 'rw19066D57…' not found
5. Single add of a text with only content → error: Node 'rwAAF59DD7…' not found
6. Single bare add of a divider → reported applied:1, but node absent from subsequent getPageContent
7. Single bare add of a flex → reported applied:1 with ref rwEF7B50F0…, but adding a child to that ID immediately failed with 'not found', and getPageContent confirmed it was never persisted
8. Fresh getPageContent then full batch again → error: Node 'rw7A2FA8A4…' not found

## Expected behaviour

add ops should insert nodes under the specified existing parent IDs (verified present via getPageContent immediately before), and applied ops should persist to the document.

## Actual behaviour

Batches fail referencing node IDs that appear in neither the request nor the live page tree (phantom IDs, different each attempt). Adds that report success are absent from the page on the next read. set ops on existing nodes in the same session applied and persisted correctly.

## Recommendations

1. Investigate document/undo-stack desync between the editing API and the open document when add ops follow generateImageResource or importChatAttachment calls
2. Make the error surface the actual failing op/parent instead of an internal phantom node ID
3. If an applied op is later rolled back, report that rather than returning applied:N

title: Project Knowledge
summary: Index of all project knowledge pages
---

This is the AI-maintained knowledge base for this project, following the Karpathy compiled-knowledge pattern. The LLM reads live pages once and compiles them into an interlinked graph of notes. Subsequent sessions read the notes, not the live pages — answers compound rather than being re-derived each time.

## Note graph

The knowledge graph lives in four folders. Use `[[folder/note]]` wikilinks for cross-references between notes.

- **pages/** — one note per live RapidWeaver page; keyed on `pageId`; records purpose, sections, components, and summary in the user's voice
- **concepts/** — themes and patterns spanning multiple pages (e.g. "testimonials pattern", "pricing section")
- **entities/** — people, clients, tools, custom components, publishing destinations
- **analyses/** — durable answers to synthesis questions; filed when a query answer is worth preserving

### When to create a concept or entity note

Create a note proactively — do not wait to be asked:

- **entities/**: any named person appearing in a role (officer, winner, organiser, contact); any named event, race, trophy, award, or external tool/service.
- **concepts/**: any structural or content pattern that appears across 3 or more pages (e.g. same image+link layout, recurring winner table structure, recurring membership pricing model).

Use a lowercase hyphenated slug (e.g. `entities/ian-wright.md`, `concepts/photo-album-pattern.md`). Add a `## See also` section with `[[folder/note]]` wikilinks back to every page note that references it, and add the reciprocal link in each of those page notes.

### Page note format

```yaml
---
title: Page Title
type: page          # page | concept | entity | analysis
pageId: <uuid>      # for type:page — the Elements page UUID (stable across sessions)
path: /slug         # site path
lastIngested: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ
sources: []         # [[links]] to notes this draws from
tags: []
concerns:           # known problems, tech debt, or gotchas for this page/concept
  - "Brief description of the issue (severity: low|medium|high)"
---

# Page Title

Summary in the user's voice. Sections, components used, index/sitemap flags.

**Build mechanics** (required — record HOW things are built, not just WHAT they render): list the element types used, any custom components and how many instances, whether data is hardcoded or driven by CMS/properties, and whether styling uses design-system tokens or bypasses them (e.g. "12 per-year hand-edited HTML custom components; data hardcoded in template; colours bypass Tailwind tokens").

## See also
- [[concepts/related-concept]]
- [[entities/entity-name]]
```

## Design System

- **[style-writing.md](style-writing.md)** — voice and tone guide; read via `getDesignSystem` before authoring copy
- **[style-visual.md](style-visual.md)** — layout and visual conventions; read via `getDesignSystem` before building pages

## Project admin

- **[overview.md](overview.md)** — site purpose, target audience, and high-level structure
- **[journal.md](journal.md)** — append-only session log (newest entries at top)
- **[concerns.md](concerns.md)** — known problems, tech debt, gotchas, and fragile areas (derived from per-note `concerns:` frontmatter + `lintKnowledge`; regenerated on close)
- **[backlog.md](backlog.md)** — outstanding work and speculative ideas with priority and status
- **[services.md](services.md)** — external services, APIs, and integrations
- **[field-reports/](field-reports/)** — structured AI session blocker reports; summaries linked from concerns.md

## Operations

Three recurring workflows — all orchestrated by the LLM using the storage primitives above.

**Ingest** (triggered by drift or new page): `getPageMarkdown(pageId)` → `editKnowledge` writePage `pages/<slug>.md` with `pageId` + `lastIngested` → touch/create linked `concepts/` and `entities/` notes → add `[[folder/note]]` wikilinks both directions and `## See also` → refresh `index.md`. If the page reveals a new voice or visual convention, call `updateDesignSystem` to reconcile the design guides.

**Query**: read `index.md` → relevant notes (re-ingest only if `stale: true`) → synthesise with `[[folder/note]]` wikilinks as citations → optionally file durable answer as `analyses/<slug>.md`. **Exception — architecture/improvement requests**: for any "how do I improve", "review", or "what's wrong with" question, always inspect the live document first (`listCustomComponents` + a sample `getCustomComponent` + `getPageContent` on representative pages) before answering, regardless of note freshness. Rank findings by altitude: maintainability/structure → design-system → content. Record findings into per-note `concerns:` and regenerate `concerns.md`.

**Lint**: call `lintKnowledge` → act on orphans, broken links, stale notes, dangling page notes, index drift → fix and log.

## 2026-08-10 — Profile page upgrade blocked by editor bug

Restyled the Profile page (light, bold, high-end): white canvas, 5xl/800 name, uppercase role label, black pill primary Email button, outlined secondary buttons, new AI-generated hipster designer avatar (resource EE0C4E57-07CB-4E36-BF6A-1D7DE9DDB15D). All `set` ops worked.

Then attempted to add new content (availability badge + bio line + 3-item Selected Work grid) and hit a persistent editor bug: **every `editPageContent` add op fails with 'Node not found' citing phantom node IDs** that exist neither in the request nor on the page; the few adds that reported success never persisted. Full details in the field report `field-reports/` (same date, 'editPageContent add ops fail with phantom Node not found errors'). User is relaunching Elements to retry.

**Pending work — resume after relaunch** (see [[concerns]]):
1. Set Bio flex (rw4049421E_AFC8_4989_91F7_B29718476105) alignItems: center
2. Add availability badge at Bio position 3: flex-row pill (border neutral,200; radius full; padding 1.5,3,1.5,3) containing a 2×2 emerald,500 dot + xs/500 neutral,700 text 'Available for projects'
3. Add bio text at Bio position 4: 'I design and build fast, beautiful websites for small studios and startups.' — p, base, center, neutral,600, relaxed, body
4. Add 'Selected Work' section in Profile Card (rw75E75512_3BEB_4494_8E0D_18E7C86CD17C) at position 2: flex-col gapY 4 with an xs uppercase widest neutral,500 heading + 3-col grid (gap 3) of three 1/1 images, radius xl:
   - work-coffee-ecommerce.png → AE35BA35-8C4F-435C-B2B5-2159C5D5CF74
   - work-brand-identity.png → 2786C424-FB40-4864-A05D-B4E588A96151
   - work-fitness-app.png → 21984935-3F38-443F-8B35-8A9BEC1D3917

All three placeholder images are already generated and in Resources — no need to regenerate.

## 2026-08-10 — Profile page upgrade completed after relaunch

Retried the pending batch after the user relaunched Elements — all ops applied successfully this time (the phantom 'Node not found' bug did not recur):

1. Bio flex set to alignItems: center
2. Availability badge added (pill with emerald,500 dot + 'Available for projects')
3. Bio line added ('I design and build fast, beautiful websites for small studios and startups.')
4. 'Selected Work' section added to Profile Card: xs uppercase heading + 3-col grid of the three work images (coffee e-commerce, brand identity, fitness app), 1/1 aspect, rounded xl

Marked the concern resolved in [[concerns]]. Page note created at [[pages/profile]].

## 2026-08-10 — Availability dot swapped to SVG

Replaced the flex-based emerald dot in the availability badge with the `circle-dot.svg` resource (SVG element, width 2, emerald,500 fill), per user request. Page note [[pages/profile]] updated.

## 2026-08-10 — Status Dot custom component

Built a 'Status Dot' custom component (pulsing availability indicator) and replaced the static circle-dot.svg in the Profile page availability badge with it. Two inspector states: Available (emerald) / Unavailable (red), plus a size control (6–24px, default 8). Pure template+CSS — state branching via class interpolation, per-instance scoped keyframes, no hooks/JS. Docs researched via sub-agent before authoring. Component notes at [[entities/status-dot]]; page note [[pages/profile]] updated.
